messages.author: 4dce7ac8c4d4567d
messages.subject: Problem installing Shiny in R
parts:
Hi,

I am getting error in installing “Shiny in R”. I have executed the command: sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\”” and i got error below:-
Warning: unable to access index for repository http://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib
Warning message:
package âshinyâ is not available (for R version 2.15.2) 

I have also tried to install it by going in the exec path of bin of my R installation directory and executed the command "install.packages('shiny')" then i got the error below:-
Warning messages:
1: In open.connection(con, "r") :
  unable to connect to 'cran.r-project.org' on port 80.
2: package âshinyâ is not available (for R version 2.15.2)

Please provide me the solution for the same.

Thanks in advance,
Mike
